name: Line-Following Robot
shortDescription: A line-following robot built for Track Trace 2.0, where our team achieved third place.
overview: A robotics competition project involving an Arduino-based robot designed to follow a track using infrared sensors.
objectives: Integrate sensors, motor control, and the controller.
Test and improve the robot's performance on the track.
role: Contributed to the robot's design and assembly.
results: Third place in the Track Trace 2.0 university competition in 2026.
